nonEolVersions.summary: The exact-source app and independent JSON3.jl test derivations execute Julia 1.13.2 on native Linux. Upstream currently identifies stable Julia 1.13.3, placing these executed points on the maintained 1.13 line; a newer patch does not by itself make the tested patch EOL. Under the clarified criterion, a tested maintained tool/runtime pair is sufficient. Separate Julia 1.10 LTS execution is not claimed and is not required for this judgment. Sample SDK credit remains 1.13.2; the separate native CLI 1.13.3 point is not substituted for sample execution.
